topic: Buy-now-pay-later's "four easy payments" reframes a purchase as smaller than it is, and the missed-payment fees can erase the entire convenience
title: The $25 Payment That's Actually $100
description:
"Four easy payments" makes a $100 purchase feel like $25. Miss just one of those payments and a late fee hits automatically -- and the fees can stack up to more than you'd have paid in interest on a normal card.

#buynowpaylater #personalfinance #moneytips #klarna #afterpay
